glosses: Garnir de vitres, de vitrages, de glaces.

translations.source_sense_description: Garnir de vitres, de vitrages, de glaces.

glosses: The vitreous coating of pottery or porcelain; anything used as a coating or color in glazing.
A transparent or semi-transparent layer of paint.
A smooth coating of ice formed on objects due to the freezing of rain; glaze ice.
Any smooth, transparent layer or coating.

examples.text: […] In the distance the flowing glaze, the breast of the river, with a wind-dapple here and there, […]

glosses: A smooth edible coating applied to food.
Broth reduced by boiling to a gelatinous paste, and spread thinly over braised dishes.
Excessive complimenting or praise, especially in a cringeworthy way.
To apply a thin, transparent layer of coating.

examples.text: An overfired biscuit has insufficient porosity for glazing.

glosses: Of eyes: to take on an uninterested appearance; to glaze over.
To compliment or praise excessively in a cringeworthy way.

translations.source_sense_description: Garnir de vitres, de vitrages, de glaces.
